output.summary: Verdict: FAIL, deterministically. The configured overall-errors policy (error_rate_ratio <= 0.01) FAILed in the run-intersection window: 3,688 errors out of 73,813 samples (~5.0%), with observed numerator 3,688 against threshold 0.01. The resource verdict is NO_POLICY because no resource policy is configured. All 3,688 errors are attributed to the checkout transaction (3,688/12,567 checkout samples, ~29.3%) and are grouped in OpenSearch as frontend.request_error from service 'frontend', appearing in discrete bursts between 1790628856826 and 1790629414273. A descriptive correlation between error rate and achieved load (partial_rho 0.9722, best_lag_ms 0) is uncalibrated (uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED, headline UNAVAILABLE/GENUINE_PARTIAL_UNCALIBRATED) and clocks are not verified, so no causal or lead/lag conclusion is supported. Analysis coverage is INCOMPLETE due to RESOURCE_GAPS: paymentservice CPU and memory series are missing cells. This advice does not change the deterministic FAIL verdict.
